input.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Dramatic, mischievous villain battle theme for the boss fight of a cartoon storybook adventure game, against a pompous wolf in a tailcoat on a stormy rooftop. Pounding timpani, heavy brass stabs and a bold swaggering trombone and tuba melody, driving low-string ostinato, snare rolls and cymbal crashes, sly chromatic woodwind runs for theatrical comic menace. Minor key, about 140 BPM, intense but fun, constant energy, no ending, loop-friendly.
